newsitem.title: USA: New NAFTA industry classification system unveiled.
newsitem.headline: New NAFTA industry classification system unveiled.

text.p: The White House's Office of Management and Budget on Tuesday unveiled a new industry classification system that it said would help the North American Free Trade Agreement partners better compare economic statistics.

The new system, called the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS), will replace NAFTA member countries' separate classification systems with one uniform system for classifying industries, the OMB said.
In the Unitd States the NAICS will replace the Standard Industrial Classification, a system used since the 1930's, OMB said.
OMB said the new system reflects changes in technology and in the growth of diversification of services in recent decades.
